using System.IO;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using MediaBrowser.Controller;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Serialization;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests
{
    public class MigrateUserDbTests
    {
        private const string TestUserDbPath = "/test/data/users.db";

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenUserDbDoesNotExist_LogsWarningAndReturns()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>>();
            var mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns("/test/data");
            var mockProvider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            var mockSerializer = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();

            var migrator = new MigrateUserDb(
                mockLogger.Object,
                mockPaths.Object,
                mockProvider.Object,
                mockSerializer.Object);

            // Act
            migrator.Perform();

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Warning),
                    It.Is<EventId>(e => true),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("{UserDbPath} doesn't exist, nothing to migrate")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                    Times.Once));
        }
    }
}

            mockLogger.Setup(x => x.Log(

            _mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _mockProvider = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<object>>();
            _mockSerializer = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();
        }

                It.IsAny<Exception>(),

            // Mock File.Exists to return false for our test path
